cohort: 520 pregnant women from an antenatal clinic who underwent a standard oral glucose tolerance test.
finding: While the prevalence of GDM was similar between WHO and IADPSG criteria, the IADPSG criteria group showed a significantly higher incidence of fetal macrosomia and cesarean section, suggesting its potential unsuitability for the study population due to later diagnosis and undertreatment.
mod_finding: GDM women diagnosed by IADPSG criteria had a significantly higher incidence of cesarean section (p = 0.012) compared to those diagnosed by WHO criteria.
